metadata.description: Knowledge work, context management, and productivity tools/skills/etc. for Claude Code

plugins.name: youtube-to-markdown
plugins.description: Transform YouTube video to storagable knowledge. Choose from summary only, transcript only, comments only, or full extraction. Get tight summary, cleaned transcript, curated comment insights, and watch guide with WATCH/SKIM/READ-ONLY gate. Browse channels to batch-extract or refresh comments. Modular architecture runs independent steps in parallel.

plugins.name: imap-slim-mcp
plugins.description: Lightweight IMAP email MCP server. Read, search, flag and draft mail; markdown or plain bodies, chosen explicitly. Multi-account. See imap-slim-cli for the same actions as a skill, which costs no context until used.

plugins.name: imap-slim-cli
plugins.description: Same IMAP mail access as imap-slim-mcp, as a skill-backed CLI. Costs no context until a command runs, where an enabled MCP server loads its tool schema into every session.

plugins.name: chrome-control
plugins.description: Control Chrome via CDP — debug web apps, run JavaScript, take screenshots, monitor console. Connects to your running Chrome session (M144+) or launches a separate instance.

plugins.name: firefox-control
plugins.description: TEST TOOL: Control Firefox via WebDriver BiDi. Direct WebSocket, no geckodriver. Daemon mode with persistent connection. navigator.webdriver=true kills production use — proves BiDi works, documents why Firefox fails for agent automation.
